_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Template Library roadmap rendered at /extensions/template-library/roadmap. Starter Sites task status is maintained by `node scripts/gen-roadmap.mjs src/data/template-store-roadmap.json` from the extension source tree; store and content tasks have no code footprint in the plugin, so they are pinned and updated by hand.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Decide
milestones.goal: Settle the product before building: what is sold, for how much, and where.

tasks.title: Sell templates, not prompts
tasks.detail: Unyson+ stays free; ready-made starter sites and landing page templates, each bought once and downloaded from the store, made your own by hand or with the AI Assistant.

tasks.title: No license key in Unyson+
tasks.detail: The plugin stays completely free: no key field, no locked items, no shop links. Kits are sold and downloaded on build.unysonplus.com and imported with the free Starter Sites import.

tasks.title: Buy each kit once
tasks.detail: No subscriptions: each kit is bought once, downloaded forever, with free updates to it (suggested $29-59 a starter site, $15-25 a landing page, 3 free kits). An All kits bundle only later, if freelancers and agencies ask for it.

tasks.title: www sells, build shows
tasks.detail: www.unysonplus.com is the shop (WooCommerce cart, checkout, PayPal / Stripe, accounts, orders, kit downloads in My Account); build.unysonplus.com is the storefront (catalog, filters, kit pages, live preview frames). The storefront reads products and prices from www through WooCommerce's public Store API, and Buy opens www's cart with the kit added. WooCommerce scripts stay off www's normal pages and www's product pages stay out of search, so the storefront pages are the ones that rank.

tasks.title: Live previews on demos subsites
tasks.detail: Each kit imported with Starter Sites onto its own demos.unysonplus.com subsite (e.g. /kit-cafe/), kept out of search, with a slim "Preview: <kit> · price · Buy" bar; forms say "this is a preview" instead of sending. The storefront shows them in desktop and phone frames.

tasks.title: Name, prices and payments
tasks.detail: Still to settle: the product name, prices, Stripe and/or PayPal, which three kits are free, the photo budget, and whether build.unysonplus.com is its own WordPress install (suggested: built on localhost first, then moved with Site Migration).

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Starter Sites import / export (free, in the Template Library)
milestones.goal: The modern successor of the original Unyson demo importer: a light package (pages, look, header and footer, menus, forms, photos) that imports without wiping the site, and the export that makes it.

tasks.title: Package format
tasks.detail: One .zip: manifest.json (type, version, needed Unyson+ version and extensions), pages as builder export envelopes, the look (Theme Settings values and presets), header and footer, menus, forms, optional sample posts, photos.

tasks.title: Export a site as a starter site
tasks.detail: Pick the pages and include the look, header / footer, menus and forms; single pages and sections export as packages too.

tasks.title: Import with choices
tasks.detail: See what a package holds, tick what to bring over; pages are added beside existing ones (never overwritten), photos go into the Media Library, links and menus are rewired; needed extensions are offered for activation.

tasks.title: Start fresh
tasks.detail: On a new site, the kit's home page becomes the front page and its header, footer, menus and look replace the current ones.

tasks.title: Undo an import
tasks.detail: The look is applied as a Theme Settings change that can be reverted; one button removes the pages, menus and photos an import added.

tasks.title: Templates with their photos
tasks.detail: "Import template…" accepts a package with photos, not only a bare .json, and "Export with photos" gives the same back.

tasks.title: AI tools and docs
tasks.detail: Import / export abilities for the AI Assistant, the public docs page, the AI Dev Kit reference and a demo.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · The store: storefront at build.unysonplus.com, shop at www.unysonplus.com
milestones.goal: Browse and preview on build.unysonplus.com, buy once and download forever on www.unysonplus.com. One shop, one source of truth for products and prices; no license system, no subscriptions.

tasks.title: Shop set-up on www
tasks.detail: Review the WooCommerce set-up already on www.unysonplus.com (Shop, Cart, Checkout, My Account) and the Membership checkout (/pay/) beside it; load WooCommerce scripts only on shop pages; keep product pages out of search.

tasks.title: Template catalog and live previews
tasks.detail: Each kit a WooCommerce downloadable product on www with its fields (type, pages, features used, preview link). On build.unysonplus.com: a gallery with filters (business type, style, starter site / landing page, free) and a page per kit with screenshots and desktop / phone preview frames, all read from www's Store API on the server and cached.

tasks.title: Cart and checkout
tasks.detail: Buy links to www's cart with the kit added; WooCommerce checkout with PayPal / Stripe, coupons, tax and invoices; free kits as free products.

tasks.title: Downloads and update emails
tasks.detail: Kit files as WooCommerce downloads on www with no limit or expiry, in My Account and the order email; replacing a file gives every past buyer the new version, and buyers are emailed when a kit they own is updated.

tasks.title: Preview subsites
tasks.detail: Each kit imported with Starter Sites on its own demos.unysonplus.com subsite: noindex, the preview bar with the price and Buy, forms that answer "this is a preview".

tasks.title: Store pages
tasks.detail: Storefront: Home, Starter sites, Landing pages, FAQ, Help. Shop (www): My Account, terms, refunds and privacy.

milestones.title: Phase 4 · The first collection
milestones.goal: Twelve original kits (six starter sites, six landing pages): three free, nine paid.

tasks.title: Kit pipeline
tasks.detail: Brief, original design, build with built-in elements and presets only, responsive / accessibility / speed checks, licensed photos with alt text, five AI-edit tests, screenshots, preview subsite, Starter Sites export.

tasks.title: Three free kits
tasks.detail: Café / restaurant and freelancer portfolio starter sites, and a SaaS launch landing page.

tasks.title: Nine paid kits
tasks.detail: Starter sites for an agency, a clinic (with Bookings), a fitness studio (with Membership) and a real estate agent; landing pages for a coach, an event, an online course, home services and a product launch.

milestones.title: Phase 5 · Launch and grow
milestones.goal: Bring Unyson+ users to the store and keep the library growing.

tasks.title: Launch
tasks.detail: A launch offer, reels and Shorts (WordPress first, Unyson+ at the end), links from unysonplus.com and the docs.

tasks.title: Two to four new kits a month
tasks.detail: New kits and sections each month; buyers vote on what comes next. An All kits bundle if freelancers and agencies ask for it.
